chunks.subject: AP Computer Science A
chunks.title: Q3 — Array / ArrayList (9 points)
chunks.content: AP CS A FRQ 3 (Array/ArrayList), 9 points, per-point criteria then penalties (max 3/question). Context: a tournament Round of Competitor objects. Part (a) Round(String[] names) constructor (4 pts): Pt1 accesses all elements of names with no bounds errors; Pt2 initializes and maintains a rank starting at 1 for each competitor (rank starting at 0 is fine if offset by 1); Pt3 constructs a Competitor with the provided name and computed rank (must use new and correct params); Pt4 adds all constructed competitors to competitorList in the correct order — the algorithm point (must update the instance variable, not redeclare it locally). Part (b) buildMatches() (5 pts): Pt5 declares and initializes a local ArrayList<Match>; Pt6 maintains an index that moves inward from both ends of competitorList; Pt7 computes the starting low index based on an even/odd size comparison; Pt8 gets two elements by index, constructs a Match, and adds it to the local list; Pt9 populates the correct number of pairs, omitting the first competitor in the odd case, with no bounds errors — the algorithm point. Common failure: not guarding even vs. odd competitor counts (Pt9); off-by-one 'high' index bounds; redeclaring competitorList as a local variable (breaks Pt4).

chunks.subject: AP Computer Science A
chunks.title: Q3 exemplar — Sample 3A, 7/9
chunks.content: Q3 scored 7/9. Earned Pt1–Pt7: a complete constructor (accesses names, maintains rank from 1, constructs Competitor, adds in order) plus buildMatches's local ArrayList (Pt5), the both-ends index (Pt6), and the even/odd starting-index (Pt7). Lost Pt8 (getting two elements, constructing a Match, and adding it) and Pt9 (populating the correct number of pairs) — the response set up the traversal but did not correctly build and add the Match pairs. Model of a correct constructor with an incomplete pairing step.

chunks.subject: AP Computer Science A
chunks.title: Q3 exemplar — Sample 3B, 6/9
chunks.content: Q3 scored 6/9. Earned Pt1, Pt3, Pt4 (constructor: accesses names, constructs Competitor, adds in order) and Pt5, Pt6, Pt8 (buildMatches: local ArrayList, both-ends index, gets elements and adds a Match). Lost Pt2 (rank not initialized/maintained correctly from 1), Pt7 (did not compute the starting low index by even/odd comparison), and Pt9 (pair count/odd-omission wrong). Illustrates a response that builds matches but mishandles the even/odd boundary and the rank.

chunks.subject: AP Computer Science A
chunks.title: Q3 exemplar — Sample 3C, 3/9
chunks.content: Q3 scored 3/9. Earned only Pt1 (accesses all elements of names), Pt6 (both-ends index in buildMatches), and Pt7 (even/odd starting index). Lost Pt3 (Competitor construction — missing new or wrong params), Pt4 (ordered-add algorithm), Pt5 (local ArrayList<Match> not properly declared/initialized), Pt8 (did not get two elements, build a Match, and add it), and Pt9 (pairing algorithm). Illustrates a low response with fragments of both parts but neither algorithm complete.
